protocol._note: M5a perception acceptance protocol, pre-registered 2026-11-19 BEFORE the revised estimator is evaluated. Evaluated by scripts/vision/replay_perception.py on recorded shadow-mode frames (validation/perception/frames/<scenario>/). Simulation benchmark only; model quantities, not clinical accuracy. Thresholds must not be loosened after seeing results; a failed gate is reported as failed.

definitions.tip_truth: tcp_M[:3,3] of the cutter tcp (true sim pose)
definitions.jaw_axis_truth: tcp_M[:3, tool_axis_col] (pointing axis used by tool_pose control)
definitions.front_truth: GroundTruth.cut_front: midpoint of the two centre columns at row round(cut_length/H) (1 mm grid quantisation)
definitions.direction_truth_live: centre-line m_j = (n[j,NU/2-1]+n[j,NU/2])/2; j0 = min(round(cut_length/H), NV-4); unit(m[j0+3]-m[j0])
definitions.direction_truth_placement: sheet_v at placement (reported for comparison with M4, not gated)
definitions.truth_visible: visibility.depth_visible on the true camera/depth with SimWorld.point_visible defaults (tol 3 mm, window 21, min_clear 0.35)
definitions.availability: #(estimate valid) / #(ticks with the sheet present AND the truth point visible)
definitions.relative_error: |(front_est - tip_est) - (front_true - tip_true)| on ticks where both estimates are valid; the quantity a relative visual servo consumes
definitions.pre_sheet_false_positive: tick with no sheet in the scene but cut.valid or cut.front_valid true

gates.basis: lower than tip: the blades can legitimately hide the slit apex in the image while the coarse truth gate (21 px window, 35 % clear) still calls the point visible

protocol.pooling: Seeds of one degradation are pooled tick-wise before computing rates/medians. A gate whose denominator is 0 is FAILED (no evidence), not passed.
protocol.closed_loop_precondition: M5b may close the loop only if every gate passes, or the user explicitly accepts a named failing gate.
_changelog: v1 2026-11-19: initial gates; M4 baseline scored (validation/perception/m5a_eval_m4_baseline.json).

v2 2026-11-19, before ANY revised-estimator evaluation: added held-out datasets (different camera pose via CAMERA_ADJUST, shaft alignment = different wrist poses, large relax deformation). The estimator is developed on `datasets` only; holdout frames are not inspected or replayed until the estimator is frozen. v1 gates unchanged.

v3 2026-11-20, BEFORE the tissue-only estimator exists and BEFORE the v3 holdout frames are captured: the v2 held-out evaluation (validation/perception/m5a_eval_holdout.json, estimator 28706e2) FAILED H_occlusion_persistent_front_vbw (0.389) and H_relax_large_front_vbw (0.375); that result stands. Those frames have now been inspected for diagnosis, so the three v2 holdout datasets are moved into `datasets` (development) with their gates kept unchanged as ordinary gates (flag former_holdout_v2). Four new held-out datasets are registered (new initial ECM views, an unseen scenario, shaft alignment under transient occlusion) with the same seven per-dataset gates as v2. All thresholds, the wrong threshold, degradations and the closed-loop precondition are unchanged. Design intent recorded for the record: the cut front must come from tissue evidence only (slit apex / intact tissue ahead); the scissors tip may only pick the near edge once, never supply or advance the front.
protocol.initial_view_note: --initial-view yaw_deg,pitch_deg commands the ECM (absolute, same convention as SimWorld.CAMERA_POSES) once after simulation start; the default (absent) is the home view used by every v1/v2 dataset.

gates.basis: lower than tip: the blades can legitimately hide the slit apex in the image while the coarse truth gate (21 px window, 35 % clear) still calls the point visible
